definition.def: To emerge means to come out from an enclosed or dark space such as a room or a vehicle, or from a position where you could not be seen.
examples: Richard was waiting outside the door as she emerged. [VERB]
The postman emerged from his van soaked to the skin. [VERB + from]
...holes made by the emerging adult beetle. [VERB-ing]

definition.def: If you emerge from a difficult or bad experience, you come to the end of it.
examples: There is growing evidence that the economy is at last emerging from recession. [VERB + from]
...their plans to emerge from bankruptcy by February of next year. [VERB from noun]

definition.def: If a fact or result emerges from a period of thought, discussion, or investigation, it becomes known as a result of it.
examples: ...the growing corruption that has emerged in the past few years. [VERB]
It soon emerged that neither the July nor August mortgage repayment had been collected. [VERB that]
The emerging caution over numbers is perhaps only to be expected. [VERB-ing]

definition.def: If someone or something emerges as a particular thing, they become recognized as that thing. [journalism]
examples: He emerged as a major figure in the reform movement. [V as n]
Vietnam has emerged as the world's third-biggest rice exporter. [VERB + as]

definition.def: When something such as an organization or an industry emerges, it comes into existence. [journalism]
examples: ...the new republic that emerged in October 1917. [VERB]
New skills are demanded for emerging industries. [VERB-ing]

examples.sentence: Excellence does not emerge without appropriate help.
The displays of art museums serve as a warning of what critical practices can emerge when spontaneous criticism is suppressed.
Then, after a few years, contrasting findings began to emerge.
The myth is that from a disorderly array of factual information an orderly, relevant theory will somehow emerge.
That may mean that more artificial intelligence companies will start to emerge to meet this challenge.
Only after the mysterious mass extinction of the dinosaurs about 65 million years ago were our ancestors able to emerge into the daylight in any substantial numbers.
These features gradually emerge as infants explore their world and interact with caregivers.
Hmm. Yes, so did one person emerge as the leader?
Scrabble over the rocks around cliff edges as the waves crash around you, dive through submerged caves and emerge onto a beach once used by smugglers.
